title: Mercator projection area inflation by latitude (x actual size)

source.name: Mercator projection area-distortion formula (area scale factor = 1 / cos² latitude)
source.publisher: Standard cartographic identity, as explained by National Geographic and university geography departments

notes: The Mercator projection preserves shape but stretches area as you move away from the equator; the area scale factor is 1/cos²(latitude). Values here are the exact geometric result of that formula, rounded.
